en.html:
In front of it. We had actually arrived.

Eastward detour, gaps in the watch, approach, then armour on and take to the air. Low all the way to the Kubo headquarters.

Not one interception.

...Too much convenience.

Thin defences or not, warriors flying a few dozen metres above the ground would be seen. Somebody had to see. Then a report to headquarters, orders to the air-defence units, and some of those units finding us.

That was my calculation. Against that much resistance, a quick breakthrough should be possible.

Optimistic? Perhaps. A little too sweet, my estimate.

Reality had opened a whole mithai shop.

Arre, have another. You have come so far. Take some for your companion also. I had allowed myself one small hopeful estimate, and now the entire tray was being pushed into my hands. Enough. A man cannot go into an enemy stronghold with this much sweetness. Where was the firing? Somebody please exercise a little hostility. We had dressed for it.

Ichijou and I stood at our destination without a scratch. Wearing armour almost seemed foolish. This infiltration was supposed to put us through hell. Why had it become so easy?

...No. Why had it been so easy?

Until we reached Raichou Imagawa's residence and saw its condition, I had not understood.

ja.html:
前に――いるのだった。
　東から回り込み、警戒線の間隙を縫って接近、折を
見て装甲騎航。低高度を保ちつつ公方府を目指した末、

　とうとう何の迎撃も受けることなく。
　
　……出来過ぎであった。

　いかに防備の薄い箇所を狙おうが、数十メートルの
低空を飛ぶ騎影は必ず目視確認される。されない筈が
ない。されれば<ruby>公方府<rt>ヘッドクォーターズ</rt></ruby>へ連絡が行こうし、行けば防空
隊にも指令が下り、その一部は俺達を捕捉するだろう。

　そう考えていた。その程度なら短時間の強行突破も
不可能ではなかろうと。
　それはむしろ、甘い目測であったのかもしれない。

　しかし現実は輪を掛けて甘く、砂糖菓子同然だった。

　装甲姿がいっそ滑稽なほどの無傷ぶりで、俺と一条
は目指した場所へ立っている。
　苛酷を窮めると思われた潜入行がここまでたやすく
成ってしまった理由はわからない。

　……否。わからな<ruby>かった<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>。
　
　あまりに容易な進攻の果て、今川雷蝶の居館へ遂に
到り、その有様を視野に収めるまでは。

en.html:
I stepped inside, through the smoke and dust. Ichijou followed.

A complete wreck.

Even if a great army had surprised them and overrun the building at once—would it have left this?

Machine-gun damage, as though somebody had fired in every direction without looking. A collapsed wall. In front of it, a mortar lying on its side, barrel bent. What was this? They had fired such a thing inside the building?

And the bodies.

Death, death, death, death. Everywhere.

All in Rokuhara uniform.

　大軍に奇襲を受け、忽ち奥まで入り込まれたのだと

を使って砲撃したとでもいうのか。

en.html:
Muramasa's mind was iron in midwinter. Hard. Cold. Yet also thick and burning, like slag just poured from a furnace.

Wearing her, I must have been much the same. Such cold and such heat together—my consciousness seemed ready to fly off somewhere beyond reach.

I ran as though chasing it. It was already trying to get ahead of what was real.

en.html:
Raichou Imagawa was dead.
The Kubo headquarters of Oyumi, destroyed.

We had done nothing.

Their enemies had arrived to find the work finished. Not one thing had we done.

Then an enemy had not destroyed them.
War had not killed them.

What else destroys a mass of people? What comes outside war and wipes them away?

Natural disaster.

A great storm full of thunder and rain. Fire carried on the wind. A tidal wave swallowing the coast. A mountain erupting in fury, turning everything around it into hell.

The same as those.

Just as sudden. Just as impossible to resist. Just as merciless.

People killed. Everything they had built, destroyed. That much only. A phenomenon.

　小弓公方府は壊滅した。

　しかし、俺達は何もしていない。
　彼らの敵であった我々は一切、何も。

　だから彼らは敵に滅ぼされたのではない。
　戦争は彼らを殺していない。

　彼らを殺し滅ぼしたものは何か。
　戦争とは全く別の、人の群れを滅ぼし去るものとは
何か。

　天災だ。
　雷雨の渦巻く大嵐。風に乗って広がる大火。沿岸を
呑み尽くす大海嘯。山の怒りが周辺全てを地獄に変え
る大噴火。

　それらと同等。
　同じように突然で、同じように抗えず、同じように
無慈悲。人を殺す。人の営みを滅ぼす。ただそれだけ
の現象。

光「いい夕焼ゆうやけだな、景明。
　まるで鬼灯ほおずきの野のようだ……」光「そうは思わないか？」景明「――銀星号ひかる!!」
